analyzed_vuln.description: Root cause is stale HashTable pointer use after duplicating properties table. In spl_fixedarray_object_get_properties(), when GC_REFCOUNT(ht) > 1 it does `intern->std.properties = zend_array_dup(ht); GC_TRY_DELREF(ht);` but continues to use the old local `ht` variable for subsequent `zend_hash_index_update()`/deletions/conversion. The updates are applied to the old table while `intern->std.properties` points to a different duplicated table, leaving inconsistent object property state. During later GC root marking, GC walks corrupted/inconsistent zvals and zval_get_type reads out of bounds (heap-buffer-overflow).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires calling SplFixedArray property materialization (e.g., via var_dump/debug info path) on a large SplFixedArray so get_properties rebuilds entries, while the std properties HashTable has refcount > 1 (as happens during these internal inspection/GC interactions). PoC `new SplFixedArray(010001000); ... var_dump($c);` causes huge index updates in spl_fixedarray_object_get_properties, enters the refcount>1 duplication branch, then uses stale `ht`; shutdown GC (`zend_gc_collect_cycles`) later traverses resulting invalid state and crashes in `gc_mark_grey`/`zval_get_type`.
